title: Thorax Ontology v0.1 - typed relationships
description: Edges added by the thorax domain. The included heart edges come from ontology/heart/relationships.json unchanged. Conventions are the heart ontology's: inverses and symmetric relations are declared once, and left_of / right_of use the subject's own left and right.

conventions.functional: No functional edges between the heart and the lungs in v0.1. Pulmonary circulation is a later addition, made together with tests on the flow animation, which derives its paths from the functional graph.
